Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Andaman Accountant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the DCPU Andaman Accountant position is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Commerce or Mathematics from a recognized university. Additionally, at least one year of relevant experience and proficiency in computer skills, including Tally, are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Accountant post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the government norms and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Accountant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Accountant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DCPU Andaman Accountant job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with required documents to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Verification, followed by an Interview, and finally Document Verification for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity offered by the District Child Protection Unit.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the District Child Protection Unit located?
faq.answer: The District Child Protection Unit is located in Mayabunder, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, with the pincode 744204.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment requires an offline application. Candidates must download the form and submit it via post.
